ex.cn: “你看了我的条子没有？” “嗯。”

ex.cn: 遭轰炸袭击之后，至少有 300 名平民下落不明。

ex.cn: 他对警察的陈述中有半个小时的事情未交代清楚。

ex.cn: 我没有听人使唤的习惯。

ex.cn: 这家族有些人可能不会受到这种疾病的影响。

senses.chn: 独立的；无党派（或组织）的

example.cn: 她不怕发生冲突。

ex.cn: 街道上垃圾之多与历史名城不协调。

fair and not influenced by your own or sb else's opinions, desires, etc.

not yet born

ex.cn: 她未出世的宝宝

ex.cn: 我刚当上叔叔（或舅舅）。

ex.cn: 按一下这里就成了！消失了。

senses.chn: 肮脏的，不洁净的（因而容易致病）

ex.cn: 不清洁的水

senses.def: considered to be bad, immoral or not pure in a religious way, and therefore not to be touched, eaten, etc.

ex.en: unclean thoughts
ex.cn: 邪念

ex.en: unclean food
ex.cn: 不洁的食物

senses.chn: 不清楚的；不确定的；难以掌握的

ex.cn: 有无损坏尚不清楚。

ex.cn: 你的图表不清楚。

ex.cn: 我不太明白你要我做什么。

ex.cn: 他欠美国政府 2 万美元税款。

ex.en: I'm sure/100% certain/absolutely positive I left my keys on the table.
ex.cn: 我肯定我把钥匙落在桌子上了。

ex.en: There's no doubt in my mind that this is the best option.
ex.cn: 我心里确信无疑，这是最佳选择。

ex.en: Without a doubt,/No question, this is where it was.
ex.cn: 毫无疑问，它原来就在这里。

ex.en: I'm not (at all) sure what time they arrive, to be honest.
ex.cn: 老实说，我（一点也）拿不准他们什么时候到。

ex.cn: 我有点儿怀疑他们是否会回电话。

senses.def: sometimes used in the past to refer to a black man who wants to please or serve white people
senses.chn: 汤姆大叔（旧时有时用以指想讨好或侍奉白人的黑人男子）

senses.def: not wearing any clothes
senses.chn: 赤裸的；裸体的；一丝不挂的

senses.def: not containing too many objects, details or unnecessary items
to become or make sth straight after it has been wound or twisted round in a circle
senses.chn: （使盘卷的东西）展开，打开；拉直

ex.en: The snake slowly uncoiled.
ex.cn: 蛇慢慢地展开了盘着的身体。

ex.en: to uncoil a rope
ex.cn: 打开盘卷的绳索

senses.def: with no colour; with no colour added
that has not been brushed or combed; very untidy
not letting you feel physically comfortable; unpleasant to wear, sit on, etc.
senses.chn: 使人不舒服的；令人不舒适的

ex.en: uncomfortable shoes
ex.cn: 不舒适的鞋子

ex.en: I couldn't sleep because the bed was so uncomfortable.
ex.cn: 这床太不舒服了，我睡不着觉。

senses.def: not feeling physically relaxed, warm, etc.
senses.chn: 感到难受的；感觉不舒服（或不暖和等）的

ex.en: I was sitting in an extremely uncomfortable position.
ex.cn: 我坐着的姿势难受极了。

ex.en: She still finds it uncomfortable to stand without support.
ex.cn: 她仍觉得没有支撑站着不太舒服。

ex.cn: 提到这个话题，他明显表现出不安。

ex.en: There was an uncomfortable silence.
ex.cn: 有一种令人不安的寂静。

senses.def: unpleasant or difficult to deal with
senses.chn: 棘手的；麻烦的；难处理的

ex.cn: 令人头痛的事实

ex.cn: 我内心惴惴不安，觉得那是我的过错。

ex.en: I became uncomfortably aware that no one else was laughing.
ex.cn: 我难堪地意识到别人都没有笑。

ex.en: Her comment was uncomfortably close to the truth.
ex.cn: 她的评论逼近真相，令人局促不安。

ex.en: He shifted uncomfortably in his seat when I mentioned money.
ex.cn: 我提到钱时，他便坐不住了。

senses.def: in a way that is not physically comfortable

ex.cn: 我觉得酷热难当。

ex.en: She perched uncomfortably on the edge of the table.
ex.cn: 她将就坐在桌边上，非常难受。

ex.cn: 这个党需要向未表明态度的选民游说拉票。

ex.cn: 不寻常的事情

ex.cn: 这药很少有副作用。

ex.en: It is not uncommon for college students to live at home.
ex.cn: 大学生住在家里并不少见。

ex.en: Red squirrels are uncommon in England.
ex.cn: 红松鼠在英格兰很少见。

senses.def: unusually large in degree or amount; great

ex.cn: 他的到来令她异常欢喜。

senses.def: to an unusual degree; extremely

ex.en: an uncommonly gifted child
ex.cn: 一个天赋异禀的儿童

senses.def: not often; not usually

ex.cn: 八月份降雨量大并非异常。

senses.def: not willing to talk to other people or give opinions
senses.chn: 不爱说话的；寡言少语的；缄默的

senses.def: not cheaper or better than others and therefore not able to compete equally
senses.chn: 无竞争力的；竞争力弱的

ex.en: an uncompetitive industry
ex.cn: 无竞争力的行业

ex.en: uncompetitive prices
ex.cn: 缺乏竞争力的价格

senses.def: not saying that you are unhappy about a difficult or unpleasant situation; not saying that you are in pain
that has not been finished
senses.chn: 未完成的；未竟的；未竣工的

ex.en: an uncompleted project
ex.cn: 未完成的项目

senses.def: simple; without any difficulty or confusion
senses.chn: 简单的；率真的；容易的；不混乱的

ex.en: an easygoing, uncomplicated young man
ex.cn: 一个随和、率直的男青年

ex.en: Why can't I have an uncomplicated life?
ex.cn: 我为什么不能过一种简朴的生活？

senses.def: rude or insulting
senses.chn: 无礼的；贬抑的；污辱性的

ex.en: uncomplimentary remarks
ex.cn: 不客气的话

senses.def: not understanding a situation or what is happening
senses.chn: 不理解的；茫然的；不领会的

senses.def: unwilling to change your opinions or behaviour
senses.chn: 不让步的；不妥协的；强硬的

ex.en: an uncompromising attitude
ex.cn: 强硬的态度

ex.en: He has a reputation for being tough and uncompromising.
ex.cn: 他的严厉和强硬态度是出了名的。

senses.def: that you do not try to hide
senses.chn: 不掩饰的；不隐藏的；明显的

ex.en: unconcealed curiosity
ex.cn: 表露无遗的好奇心

senses.def: a lack of care, interest or worry about sth that other people would care about

ex.en: She received the news with apparent unconcern.
ex.cn: 她接到这消息时显然无动于衷。

senses.def: not worried or anxious about sth because you feel it does not affect you or is not important
senses.chn: 冷淡的；漠视的；漫不经心的

ex.en: He drove on, apparently unconcerned about the noise the engine was making.
ex.cn: 他继续驾车前进，对发动机发出的噪声显然毫不在意。

senses.def: not interested in sth

ex.cn: 青年人对政治问题往往漠不关心。

senses.def: without any conditions or limits
senses.chn: 无条件的；无限制的；绝对的

ex.en: the unconditional surrender of military forces
ex.cn: 军队的无条件投降

ex.en: She gave her children unconditional love.
ex.cn: 她将爱毫无保留地给了她的孩子。

senses.def: not trained or influenced by experience; natural

ex.en: an unconditioned response
ex.cn: 无条件反应

senses.def: not limited in space, range or amount

ex.en: The animals have unconfined access to pasture.
ex.cn: 这些动物是散养的。

ex.en: When the news came through joy was unconfined.
ex.cn: 听到消息时无比喜悦。

senses.chn: 未经证实的；未被认可的；未确认的

ex.cn: 未证实的传言

ex.cn: 未经证实的报道称至少有六人丧生。

senses.def: not pleasant or friendly; not like yourself
senses.chn: 不友善的；性情不相投的

ex.en: uncongenial company
ex.cn: 脾气不相投的同伴

senses.def: not pleasant; not making you feel relaxed; not suitable for your personality
senses.chn: 不愉快的；令人紧张的；不适宜的

ex.en: an uncongenial atmosphere
ex.cn: 不和谐的气氛

senses.def: not suitable for sth; not encouraging sth

ex.en: The religious climate at the time was uncongenial to new ideas.
ex.cn: 当时的宗教气候容不得新思想。

senses.def: not related or connected in any way

ex.en: The two crimes are apparently unconnected.
ex.cn: 这两起犯罪显然没有关联。

ex.en: My resignation was totally unconnected with recent events.
ex.cn: 我的辞职与最近的事件毫不相干。

example.en: My resignation was totally unconnected with recent events.
example.cn: 我的辞职与最近的事件毫不相干。

senses.def: too strong to be defeated or changed
senses.chn: 不可战胜的；坚不可摧的；难以改变的

senses.def: so bad, immoral, etc. that it should make you feel ashamed
too great, large, long, etc.
senses.chn: 过分的；过于大（或多、长等）的

senses.def: in a state like sleep because of an injury or illness, and not able to use your senses
senses.chn: 无知觉的；昏迷的；不省人事的

ex.en: She was knocked unconscious.
ex.cn: 她被打昏了。

ex.en: They found him lying unconscious on the floor.
ex.cn: 他们发现他晕倒在地板上。

senses.def: existing or happening without you realizing or being aware; not deliberate or controlled

ex.en: unconscious desires
ex.cn: 自然流露的欲望

ex.en: The brochure is full of unconscious humour.
ex.cn: 这本小册子妙趣横生。

senses.chn: 未察觉；未意识到；未注意

ex.cn: 她没有察觉自己对大众的影响。

ex.en: He was quite unconscious of the danger.
ex.cn: 他丝毫没有意识到危险。

senses.chn: 无意识（不察觉的心理活动）

ex.en: Perhaps, unconsciously, I've done something to offend her.
ex.cn: 我也许无意中做了什么得罪她的事。

ex.en: He had lapsed into unconsciousness.
ex.cn: 他陷入了昏迷状态。

senses.chn: 未经（或欠）考虑的；未经深思熟虑的

ex.cn: 我对我那些考虑不周的言辞开始感到后悔。

senses.chn: 违背宪法的；违反宪章（或章程）的

senses.def: not restricted or limited

ex.cn: 自然生长

senses.chn: 未被损害的；未受污染的

ex.en: uncontaminated water
ex.cn: 未被污染的水

senses.chn: 没有（或不容易）引起争议的

ex.cn: 这个建议并没有什么重大的争议。

senses.def: without any opposition or argument

ex.en: an uncontested election/divorce
ex.cn: 无争议的选举／离婚

ex.en: These claims have not gone uncontested.
ex.cn: 这些说法并非无人提出异议。

senses.def: that you cannot control or prevent
senses.chn: 无法控制的；难以防止的；禁不住的

ex.en: an uncontrollable temper
ex.cn: 控制不住的脾气

ex.en: uncontrollable bleeding
ex.cn: 止不住的流血

ex.en: I had an uncontrollable urge to laugh.
ex.cn: 我忍不住想笑。

ex.en: The ball was uncontrollable.
ex.cn: 球控制不住了。

ex.en: He's an uncontrollable child (= he behaves very badly and cannot be controlled).
ex.cn: 他是个难以管教的孩子。

senses.def: that sb cannot control or stop
senses.chn: 抑制不住的；无法制止的

ex.en: uncontrolled anger
ex.cn: 克制不住的愤怒

ex.en: The thoughts rushed into my mind uncontrolled.
ex.cn: 各种想法如潮水般涌上我的心头。

senses.def: that is not limited or managed by law or rules
senses.chn: 不受法律（或规则）制约的；无序的

ex.en: the uncontrolled growth of cities
ex.cn: 城市的无规划发展

ex.en: uncontrolled dumping of toxic wastes
ex.cn: 有毒废弃物的胡乱弃置

senses.chn: 无争议的；不会引起不和的

ex.en: an uncontroversial opinion
ex.cn: 无争议的意见

ex.en: He chose an uncontroversial topic for his speech.
ex.cn: 他为自己的演讲选择了一个不会引起争议的话题。

senses.def: not following what is done or considered normal or acceptable by most people; different and interesting
senses.chn: 不因循守旧的；不因袭的；新奇的

ex.en: an unconventional approach to the problem
ex.cn: 解决这个问题的非常规方法

ex.en: unconventional views
ex.cn: 新奇的观点

senses.def: not believing or not certain about sth despite what you have been told

ex.en: I remain unconvinced of the need for change.
ex.cn: 我仍怀疑改革的必要性。

ex.en: She seemed unconvinced by their promises.
ex.cn: 她似乎不相信他们的许诺。

ex.en: The jury were unconvinced that he was innocent.
ex.cn: 陪审团不相信他是无辜的。

example.en: I remain unconvinced of the need for change.
example.cn: 我仍怀疑改革的必要性。

example.en: She seemed unconvinced by their promises.
example.cn: 她似乎不相信他们的许诺。

example.en: The jury were unconvinced that he was innocent.
example.cn: 陪审团不相信他是无辜的。

senses.chn: 似乎不真实的；不令人信服的；难以相信的

ex.en: I find the characters in the book very unconvincing.
ex.cn: 我觉得书中的人物很不真实。

ex.en: She managed a weak, unconvincing smile.
ex.cn: 她勉强挤出一丝笑意。

ex.en: Eat plenty of uncooked fruit and vegetables.
ex.cn: 要多吃生的水果和蔬菜。

senses.def: not considered acceptable by fashionable young people
senses.chn: 不时髦的；不帅的；不潇洒的；不 “酷” 的

senses.def: not willing to be helpful to other people or do what they ask
senses.chn: 不愿合作的；不愿配合的

senses.def: if a person is uncoordinated, they are not able to control their movements well, and are therefore not very skilful at some sports and physical activities
senses.chn: 动作不协调的；不灵便的；手脚笨拙的

senses.def: not controlled; not moving smoothly or together
not well organized; with no thought for how the different parts work together
senses.chn: 不缜密的；无通盘安排的；缺乏全面考虑的

senses.def: to open a bottle by removing the cork from the top
not supported by any other evidence; not having been corroborated
a noun that is uncountable cannot be made plural or used with a or an, for example water, bread and information
an uncountable noun
to remove the connection between two vehicles, two parts of a train, etc.
senses.chn: 使（车辆、车厢等）分离；分开（连在一起的两个）

senses.def: rude or socially unacceptable
senses.chn: 粗鲁的；无礼的；无教养的

ex.en: uncouth laughter
ex.cn: 粗野的笑声

ex.en: an uncouth young man
ex.cn: 一个无教养的年轻人

senses.def: to remove sth that is covering sth

ex.en: Uncover the pan and let the soup simmer.
ex.cn: 揭开锅盖，让汤再慢火煨一下。

ex.cn: 警方发现了一个绑架总统之子的阴谋。

senses.chn: 裸露的；暴露的；无覆盖的

ex.en: His head was uncovered.
ex.cn: 他光着头。

senses.chn: 不愿批评的；不置可否的；不得罪人的

ex.cn: 我说什么她都不论对错一概接受，这倒惹我不耐烦起来。

senses.def: not full of people

ex.en: The beach was pleasantly uncrowded.
ex.cn: 海滩上人不多，很是惬意。

senses.def: not yet crowned
the person considered to be the best, most famous or successful in a particular place or area of activity
senses.chn: 无冕之王（某地区或领域中最杰出的人）

behaviour or speech that is not sincere and that expresses too much praise or admiration of sb
senses.chn: 虚情假意的行为（或讲话）；奉承；甜言蜜语

senses.def: friendly or giving praise in a way that is not sincere and which is therefore unpleasant
senses.chn: 谄媚的；油滑的；拍马奉迎的

not well educated; not able to understand or enjoy art, literature, etc.
senses.chn: 缺乏教养的；不文雅的；粗俗的

ex.cn: 那条蛇慢慢地伸开了蜷缩的身子。

ex.cn: 那猫伸直了腰跳下墙头。

example.en: The cat uncurled itself and jumped off the wall.
example.cn: 那猫伸直了腰跳下墙头。

senses.def: left to grow; not cut short

ex.en: The uncut grass came up to her waist.
ex.cn: 未割的草齐了她的腰。

senses.def: left in its complete form; without any parts removed; not censored
senses.chn: 未删节的；未删剪的；未审查的

ex.en: the original uncut version
ex.cn: 未删节的原版

senses.def: not shaped by cutting

ex.en: uncut diamonds
ex.cn: 未雕琢的钻石

senses.def: not damaged or spoilt

ex.en: There was a slight collision but my car was undamaged.
ex.cn: 虽有轻微碰撞，但我的汽车没有损坏。

ex.en: He emerged from the court case with his reputation undamaged.
ex.cn: 他挺过了官司，名声没有受损。

senses.def: without a date written or printed on it

ex.en: an undated letter
ex.cn: 一封没写日期的信

senses.def: of which the date is not known
senses.chn: 日期不明的；时间不详的

ex.en: undated archaeological remains
ex.cn: 时间未确定的考古遗迹

senses.def: still enthusiastic and determined, despite difficulties or disappointment
senses.chn: 顽强；百折不挠；坚强不屈

ex.cn: 尽管他的思想屡遭非难，他似乎仍然百折不挠。

senses.def: not having made a decision about sb/sth

ex.cn: 我还拿不定主意投谁的票。

ex.en: He was undecided as to what to do next.
ex.cn: 他对下一步要做什么犹豫不决。

senses.def: not having been decided

ex.en: The venue for the World Cup remains undecided.
ex.cn: 世界杯的举办地点尚未确定。

example.en: I'm still undecided (about) who to vote for.
example.cn: 我还拿不定主意投谁的票。

example.en: He was undecided as to what to do next.
example.cn: 他对下一步要做什么犹豫不决。

senses.def: not admitted to; not stated in an open way; not having been declared
senses.chn: 未承认的；未声明的；未申报的

senses.def: any of the principles of classical or neoclassical theatre that restrict the action of a play to a single story, day and place
senses.chn: （情节、时间和地点的）统一性，一致性；三一律

ex.en: the unities of action, time and place
ex.cn: 要求情节、时间和地点一致的三一律

senses.def: a single thing that may consist of a number of different parts

ex.en: If society is to exist as a unity, its members must have shared values.
ex.cn: 社会若要成为一个统一的群体，它的成员就必须有共同的价值观。

senses.def: the number one
done by or involving all the people in the world or in a particular group
senses.chn: 普遍的；全体的；全世界的；共同的

ex.en: Such problems are a universal feature of old age.
ex.cn: 这类问题是老年人的通病。

ex.en: Agreement on this issue is almost universal.
ex.cn: 这个问题几乎取得全体一致的意见。

ex.en: universal suffrage (= the right of all the people in a country to vote)
ex.cn: 普选权

senses.def: true or right at all times and in all places
senses.chn: 普遍存在的；广泛适用的

ex.en: universal facts about human nature
ex.cn: 人性的普遍现象

senses.def: the set of rules that is thought to be able to describe all languages
senses.chn: 普遍语法（据信能够描述所有语言的一系列规则）

senses.def: a substance that changes colour when another substance touches it, indicating whether it is an acid or an alkali
senses.chn: 通用指示剂（通过颜色变化显示物质的酸碱性）

senses.def: by everyone

ex.en: to be universally accepted
ex.cn: 得到普遍接受

senses.def: everywhere or in every situation
senses.chn: 到处；随时随地；在各种情况下

ex.en: This treatment is not universally available.
ex.cn: 这种疗法不是到处都有的。

ex.en: The theory does not apply universally.
ex.cn: 这个理论并非放之四海而皆准。

senses.def: the whole of space and everything in it, including the earth, the planets and the stars

ex.en: theories of how the universe began
ex.cn: 关于宇宙形成的各种理论

senses.def: a system of stars, planets, etc. in space outside our own

ex.en: The idea of a parallel universe is hard to grasp.
ex.cn: 平行宇宙的概念是很难理解的。

ex.en: He lives in a little universe of his own.
ex.cn: 他生活在自己的小天地里。

senses.def: a particular area of experience or activity

ex.en: the moral universe
ex.cn: 道德体系

senses.def: an institution at the highest level of education where you can study for a degree or do research

ex.en: Is there a university in this town?
ex.cn: 这座城市有没有大学？

ex.en: Ohio State University
ex.cn: 俄亥俄州立大学

ex.en: the University of York
ex.cn: 约克大学

ex.en: York University
ex.cn: 约克大学

ex.en: Both their children are at university.
ex.cn: 他们的两个孩子都在上大学。

ex.en: He's hoping to go to university next year.
ex.cn: 他希望明年能上大学。

senses.def: the experience of life thought of as giving sb an education, instead of the person gaining formal qualifications
senses.chn: 人生大学（生活体验，相对于正式学历）

ex.en: a degree from the university of life
ex.cn: 人生大学学位

senses.def: not deserved or fair
senses.chn: 不公平的；不公正的；非正义的

ex.en: an unjust law
ex.cn: 不公正的法律

senses.def: impossible to excuse or accept because there is no good reason for it
senses.chn: 不可原谅的；无法接受的；无正当理由的

ex.en: an unjustifiable delay
ex.cn: 无理的拖延

senses.def: not fair or necessary
senses.chn: 不公正的；不正当的；不必要的

ex.en: The criticism was wholly unjustified.
ex.cn: 这样的批评完全是不公平的。

senses.def: not well cared for; not neat or tidy
senses.chn: 不整洁的；凌乱的；不修边幅的

ex.en: greasy, unkempt hair
ex.cn: 油乎乎乱蓬蓬的头发

senses.def: unpleasant or unfriendly; slightly cruel
senses.chn: 不友善的；不亲切的；不客气的；刻薄的

ex.en: an unkind remark
ex.cn: 不友善的话

ex.en: He was never actually unkind to them.
ex.cn: 其实他从没有对他们不好。

ex.en: It would be unkind to go without him.
ex.cn: 甩掉他那就太不够朋友了。

senses.def: that cannot be known

ex.en: a distant, unknowable divine power
ex.cn: 遥远不可知的神力

senses.def: not aware of what you are doing or what is happening
senses.chn: 没意识到的；未察觉的；无知的

ex.en: He was the unknowing cause of all the misunderstanding.
ex.cn: 他无意中引起了这一切误会。

senses.def: not known or identified
senses.chn: 未知的；不详的；未被确认的

ex.en: a species of insect previously unknown to science
ex.cn: 科学上以前尚未了解的一种昆虫

ex.en: He was trying, for some unknown reason, to count the stars.
ex.cn: 不知何故，他试图数星星。

ex.en: The man's identity remains unknown.
ex.cn: 这名男子的身份还是个谜。

senses.def: not famous or well known

ex.en: an unknown actor
ex.cn: 没有名气的演员

ex.en: The author is virtually unknown outside Poland.
ex.cn: 在波兰以外，这位作者实际上鲜为人知。

senses.def: never happening or existing
senses.chn: 从未发生的；从不存在的

ex.en: The disease is as yet unknown in Europe (= there have been no cases there).
ex.cn: 这种疾病至今尚未在欧洲出现过。

ex.en: It was not unknown for people to have to wait several hours (= it happened sometimes).
ex.cn: 人们得等几个小时的事时有发生。

senses.def: a person or thing whose qualities or abilities are not yet known
senses.chn: 未知数（指尚不清楚，有待证实的人或事物）

senses.def: without the person mentioned being aware of it

ex.en: Unknown to me, he had already signed the agreement.
ex.cn: 他背着我已签了协议。

senses.def: places or things that are not known about

ex.en: a journey into the unknown
ex.cn: 探险之旅

ex.en: a fear of the unknown
ex.cn: 对未知事物的恐惧

senses.def: a person who is not well known

ex.en: A young unknown played the leading role.
ex.cn: 演主角的是一个名不见经传的年轻人。

senses.def: a fact or an influence that is not known
senses.chn: 不明的情况；未知的因素

ex.en: There are so many unknowns in the proposal.
ex.cn: 这项提案中的未知数太多了。

senses.def: a quantity that does not have a known value

ex.en: X and Y in the equation are both unknowns.
ex.cn: 等式中的 X 和 Y 都是未知数。

senses.def: without the person mentioned being aware of it

ex.en: Unknown to me, he had already signed the agreement.
ex.cn: 他背着我已签了协议。

senses.def: to undo the laces of shoes, clothes, etc.
senses.chn: 解开（鞋子、衣服等）的带子

senses.def: not loaded

ex.en: a vehicle with an unladen weight of 3 000 kg
ex.cn: 净重 3 吨的汽车

senses.def: not allowed by the law
senses.chn: 不合法的；非法的；违法的

senses.def: a murder or other killing which is considered a crime, for example when a person dies because sb is careless
senses.chn: 非法杀人（包括因疏忽导致他人死亡）

ex.en: The two police officers were accused of unlawful killing.
ex.cn: 这两名警员被控非法杀人。

senses.def: not containing lead2 (1) and therefore less harmful to the environment
to deliberately forget sth that you have learned, especially sth bad or wrong
senses.chn: 故意忘却（尤指错事或坏事）；抛弃

ex.en: You'll have to unlearn all the bad habits you learned with your last piano teacher.
ex.cn: 你必须丢掉你的前任钢琴老师所教的一切坏习惯。

senses.def: to suddenly let a strong force, emotion, etc. be felt or have an effect

ex.en: The government's proposals unleashed a storm of protest in the press.
ex.cn: 政府的提案引发了新闻界的抗议浪潮。

senses.def: made without any yeast and therefore flat
senses.chn: 未发酵的；不加酵母的；死面的

senses.def: used to say that sth can only happen or be true in a particular situation

ex.en: You won't get paid for time off unless you have a doctor's note.
ex.cn: 除非你有医生证明，否则你不上班便拿不到工资。

ex.en: I won't tell them—not unless you say I can.
ex.cn: 我绝不告诉他们，除非你允许。

ex.en: Unless I'm mistaken, she was back at work yesterday.
ex.cn: 除非是我记错了，她是昨天回来上班的。

ex.en: He hasn't got any hobbies—unless you call watching TV a hobby.
ex.cn: 他没有什么爱好，除非你把看电视也称作爱好。

senses.def: used to give the only situation in which sth will not happen or be true

ex.en: I sleep with the window open unless it's really cold.
ex.cn: 天气若不很冷，我总开着窗户睡觉。

ex.en: Unless something unexpected happens, I'll see you tomorrow.
ex.cn: 如果不出意外，我明天去看你。

ex.en: Have a cup of tea—unless you'd prefer a cold drink?
ex.cn: 喝杯茶吧，还是你喜欢冷饮？

senses.def: unable to read
without a licence

ex.en: an unlicensed vehicle
ex.cn: 无牌照车辆

senses.def: different from a particular person or thing

ex.en: Music is quite unlike any other art form.
ex.cn: 音乐与其他艺术形式迥然不同。

ex.en: The sound was not unlike that of birds singing.
ex.cn: 这声音有点像鸟鸣。

senses.def: used to contrast sb/sth with another person or thing

ex.en: Unlike most systems, this one is very easy to install.
ex.cn: 本系统与多数系统不同，极易安装。

ex.en: This survey highlights a number of differences in the way that teenage boys and girls in the UK spend their free time.
ex.cn: 这项民意测验凸显出英国十几岁的男孩和女孩在打发闲暇时间上的诸多不同。

ex.en: One of the main differences between the girls and the boys who took part in the research was the way in which they use the Internet.
ex.cn: 参与了这项研究的女生和男生之间的主要差异之一在于他们使用互联网的方式。

ex.en: Unlike the girls, who use the Internet mainly to keep in touch with friends, the boys questioned in this survey tend to use the Internet for playing computer games.
ex.cn: 女生使用互联网主要是和朋友联系，这一点和男生不同，参与调查的男生往往是使用互联网来玩电脑游戏。

ex.en: The girls differ from the boys in that they tend to spend more time keeping in touch with friends on the telephone or on social networking websites.
ex.cn: 与男生不同的是，女生往往花更多的时间通过电话或社交网站与朋友保持联系。

ex.en: Compared to the boys, the girls spend much more time chatting to friends on the telephone.
ex.cn: 与男生相比，女生花在与朋友电话聊天上的时间要多得多。

senses.def: not typical of sb/sth

ex.en: It's very unlike him to be so late.
ex.cn: 迟到这么久可实在不像他平时的作风。

senses.def: different from each other

ex.en: They are both teachers. Otherwise they are quite unlike.
ex.cn: 他们两位都是教师；除此之外他们迥然不同。

senses.def: to show that you no longer like or agree with sth on a social networking service, news website, blog , etc. by pressing a special button
senses.chn: （在社交网络、新闻网站、博客等上）对…取消点赞

senses.def: not likely to happen; not probable

ex.en: The project seemed unlikely to succeed.
ex.cn: 这个项目似乎难以成功。

ex.en: It's most (= very) unlikely that she'll arrive before seven.
ex.cn: 她几乎不可能在七点前到达。

ex.en: In the unlikely event of a problem arising, please contact the hotel manager.
ex.cn: 万一出现问题，请找旅馆经理。

ex.en: It's pretty much inevitable that prices will go up this year.
ex.cn: 今年价格上涨几乎是不可避免的了。

ex.en: I think it's likely to rain this afternoon.
ex.cn: 我觉得今天下午有可能下雨。

ex.en: I'm probably going to be away then.
ex.cn: 到那时候我可能就要离开了。

senses.def: not the person, thing or place that you would normally think of or expect
senses.chn: 非心目中的；意料之外的

ex.en: He seems a most unlikely candidate for the job.
ex.cn: 他似乎是最不适合担任这项工作的人选。

ex.en: They have built hotels in the most unlikely places.
ex.cn: 他们把旅馆建在最冷门的地方。

senses.def: difficult to believe
senses.chn: 难以相信的；不能信服的

ex.en: She gave me an unlikely explanation for her behaviour.
ex.cn: 她对自己行为的解释很难令我信服。

example.en: The project seemed unlikely to succeed.
example.cn: 这个项目似乎难以成功。

example.en: It's most (= very) unlikely that she'll arrive before seven.
example.cn: 她几乎不可能在七点前到达。

senses.def: as much or as many as is possible; not limited in any way
senses.chn: 尽量多的；任意多的；无限制的

ex.en: The ticket gives you unlimited travel for seven days.
ex.cn: 凭本车票在七日内可自由乘车不受限制。

ex.en: The court has the power to impose an unlimited fine for this offence.
ex.cn: 法庭有权对这一违法行为罚款，额度不受限制。

ex.en: You will be allowed unlimited access to the files.
ex.cn: 你可以无限制使用这些档案。

senses.def: not marked with lines

ex.en: unlined paper/skin
ex.cn: 无横格的纸；无皱纹的皮肤

senses.def: made without an extra layer of cloth on the inside
not on a published list, especially of stock exchange prices
senses.chn: 未列表公布的；（尤指证券）未挂牌的，未上市的

ex.en: an unlisted company
ex.cn: 非上市公司

senses.def: not listed in the public telephone book, at the request of the owner of the telephone. The telephone company will not give unlisted numbers to people who ask for them.
dark because there are no lights or the lights are not switched on

ex.en: an unlit passage
ex.cn: 无灯光的通道

senses.def: not yet burning

ex.en: an unlit cigarette
ex.cn: 未点燃的香烟

senses.def: to remove things from a vehicle or ship after it has taken them somewhere

ex.en: Everyone helped to unload the luggage from the car.
ex.cn: 大家都帮着从汽车上卸行李。

ex.en: This isn't a suitable place to unload the van.
ex.cn: 这个地方不适宜卸车。

ex.en: The truck driver was waiting to unload.
ex.cn: 卡车司机在等着卸货。

senses.def: to remove the contents of sth after you have finished using it, especially the bullets from a gun or the film from a camera
senses.chn: 拆掉，退出，取出（子弹或胶卷等）

senses.def: to pass the responsibility for sb/sth to sb else

ex.en: It's his problem, not something he should unload onto you.
ex.cn: 那是他的事，他不该把问题甩给你。

senses.def: to get rid of or sell sth, especially sth illegal or of bad quality
senses.chn: 脱手，卖掉（尤指非法物品或次品）

ex.en: They want to unload their shares at the right price.
ex.cn: 他们想在价格合适的时候卖掉股票。

example.en: Everyone helped to unload the luggage from the car.
example.cn: 大家都帮着从汽车上卸行李。

example.en: This isn't a suitable place to unload the van.
example.cn: 这个地方不适宜卸车。

senses.def: to undo the lock of a door, window, etc., using a key

ex.en: to unlock the door
ex.cn: 打开门锁

senses.def: to discover sth and let it be known

ex.en: The divers hoped to unlock some of the secrets of the seabed.
ex.cn: 潜水员希望揭开海底的一些秘密。

senses.def: to enable a mobile/cell phone to use any network rather than only one particular one

ex.en: Have an old phone lying around? Unlock it and keep it as a spare.
ex.cn: 有闲置的旧手机？把它解除网络锁定留作备用吧。

senses.def: not locked

ex.en: Don't leave your desk unlocked.
ex.cn: 请不要忘记锁好办公桌。

senses.def: not expected
senses.chn: 没想到的；不期的；意外的

ex.en: unlooked-for developments
ex.cn: 意料之外的发展

senses.def: to make sth loose

ex.en: He unloosed his tie.
ex.cn: 他松开了领带。

senses.def: not loved by anyone

ex.en: unloved children
ex.cn: 无人疼爱的孩子

senses.def: not attractive
senses.chn: 不好看的；不动人的；不美观的

ex.en: an unlovely building
ex.cn: 不美观的建筑物

senses.def: unfortunately; as a result of bad luck

ex.en: He was injured in the first game and unluckily missed the final.
ex.cn: 他第一场比赛就受了伤，遗憾地未能参加决赛。

senses.def: having bad luck or happening because of bad luck; not lucky
senses.chn: 不幸的；倒霉的；不顺利的

ex.en: He was very unlucky not to win.
ex.cn: 他不幸输了。

ex.en: By some unlucky chance, her name was left off the list.
ex.cn: 倒霉的是，名单上没有她的名字。

senses.def: causing bad luck

ex.en: Some people think it's unlucky to walk under a ladder.
ex.cn: 有些人认为从梯子下面走过不吉利。

ex.en: Thirteen is often considered an unlucky number.
ex.cn: 十三常被认为是不吉利的数字。

senses.def: an unmade bed is not ready for sleeping in because the sheets, etc. have not been arranged neatly
an unmade road does not have a hard smooth surface
difficult or impossible to control or deal with
senses.chn: 难以控制（或处理）的；无法对付的

senses.def: not having the qualities that are admired or expected in a man
senses.chn: 非男子汉的；无男子气概的

senses.def: if a machine, a vehicle, a place or an activity is unmanned, it does not have or need a person to control or operate it
senses.chn: 无（需）人操作的；无（需）人控制的；自控的

ex.en: an unmanned spacecraft
ex.cn: 无人驾驶宇宙飞船

ex.en: an unmanned Mars mission
ex.cn: 无人火星探测

senses.def: not having or showing good manners; not polite
without a sign or words to show what or where sth is
senses.chn: 无标志的；无标记的；无记号的

ex.en: an unmarked police car
ex.cn: 无标识的警车

ex.en: He was buried in an unmarked grave.
ex.cn: 他埋在一处无名冢下。

senses.def: with no player from the other team staying close to prevent them from getting the ball

ex.en: He headed the ball to the unmarked Gray.
ex.cn: 他把球顶给了无人盯防的格雷。

senses.def: not showing any particular feature or style, such as being formal or informal
not married

ex.en: an unmarried mother
ex.cn: 未婚母亲

senses.def: to show the true character of sb, or a hidden truth about sth

ex.en: to unmask a spy
ex.cn: 揭发间谍

senses.def: better than all others

ex.en: He had a talent unmatched by any other politician of this century.
ex.cn: 他的才华是本世纪其他政坛人物望尘莫及的。

senses.def: that cannot be remembered because it was not special
too shocking or embarrassing to be mentioned or spoken about
senses.chn: 不可提及的；不宜述说的；难以启齿的

ex.en: an unmentionable disease
ex.cn: 羞于启齿的疾病

senses.def: not satisfied

ex.en: a report on the unmet needs of elderly people
ex.cn: 有关老年人生活所需不足的报告

senses.def: not giving thought or attention to sb/sth
senses.chn: 不注意的；不留心的；漫不经心的

senses.def: that you must not miss because it is so good
senses.chn: 不能错过的；不可失掉的

ex.en: an unmissable opportunity
ex.cn: 不能错过的良机

senses.def: that cannot be mistaken for sb/sth else
senses.chn: 不会弄错的；确定无疑的；清楚明白的

ex.en: Her accent was unmistakable.
ex.cn: 她的口音是很明显的。

ex.en: the unmistakable sound of gunfire
ex.cn: 清清楚楚的枪炮声

senses.def: used to mean 'complete', usually when describing sth bad
senses.chn: 完全的，十足的，彻底的（通常指坏事）

ex.en: The evening was an unmitigated disaster.
ex.cn: 这一晚完全是一场灾难。

senses.def: not modified
not disturbed or attacked by sb; not prevented from doing sth
senses.chn: 不受打搅（或攻击）；未受阻挠；不被干涉

senses.def: not having interest in or enthusiasm for sth, especially work or study
senses.chn: （尤指对工作或学习）缺乏动机的，不感兴趣的，无热情的

ex.en: unmotivated students
ex.cn: 缺乏动力的学生

senses.def: without a reason or motive

ex.en: an unmotivated attack
ex.cn: 无缘无故的攻击

senses.def: not feeling pity or sympathy, especially in a situation where it would be normal to do so
senses.chn: 冷漠的；无同情心的；无动于衷的

ex.en: Alice seemed totally unmoved by the whole experience.
ex.cn: 艾丽斯似乎对整个经过十分冷漠。

ex.en: She pleaded with him but he remained unmoved.
ex.cn: 她苦苦哀求，可是他仍无动于衷。

senses.def: not moving

ex.en: He stood, unmoving, in the shadows.
ex.cn: 他一动不动地站在阴暗处。

senses.def: unpleasant to listen to
senses.chn: 难听的；刺耳的；不悦耳的

ex.en: His voice was harsh and unmusical.
ex.cn: 他的声音刺耳难听。

senses.def: unable to play or enjoy music
senses.chn: 不擅长音乐的；对音乐无兴趣的

senses.def: whose name is not given or not known
senses.chn: 未披露姓名的；不知姓名的

ex.en: information from an unnamed source
ex.cn: 不愿透露姓名的人提供的消息

ex.en: Two casualties, as yet unnamed, are still in the local hospital.
ex.cn: 两个尚不知姓名的伤者仍在当地医院。

senses.def: different from what is normal or expected, or from what is generally accepted as being right
senses.chn: 不自然的；勉强的；反常的

ex.en: It seems unnatural for a child to spend so much time alone.

senses.def: not feeling or showing any sympathy
senses.chn: 无同情心的；不表示同情的；冷漠的

ex.en: I told him about the problem but he was totally unsympathetic.
ex.cn: 我把麻烦事告诉了他，但他完全无动于衷。

senses.def: not in agreement with sth; not supporting an idea, aim, etc.
senses.chn: （与…）不一致的；有分歧的；（与某意见、目的等）相违的

ex.en: The government was unsympathetic to public opinion.
ex.cn: 政府违背了民意。

senses.def: not easy to like; unpleasant
not organized into a clear system
senses.chn: 无系统的；紊乱的；杂乱无章的

senses.def: not damaged or spoiled by sth unpleasant; not tainted
senses.chn: 未受损害的；未被污染的；未被玷污的

senses.def: without a natural ability to do sth well
senses.chn: 无天赋的；没有特别天分的

senses.def: allowed to remain in a wild state; not changed, controlled or influenced by anyone; not tamed
senses.chn: 野性的；未驯服的；未受抑制的；未调教的

senses.def: to undo string, hair, wire, etc. that has become twisted or has knots in it
to make sth that is complicated or confusing easier to deal with or understand
available but not yet used
senses.chn: 未利用的；未开发的；蕴藏的

ex.en: untapped reserves of oil
ex.cn: 未开采的石油储量

senses.def: that cannot be defended against attack or criticism
senses.chn: 难以捍卫的；站不住脚的；不堪一击的

ex.en: His position had become untenable and he was forced to resign.
ex.cn: 他的地位已难以维持，因此他被迫辞职。

senses.def: not tested; of unknown quality or value
impossible to imagine or accept
senses.chn: 难以想象的；不可思议的；难以置信的

ex.en: It was unthinkable that she could be dead.
ex.cn: 她竟然去世了，真是很难相信。

senses.def: not thinking about the effects of what you do or say; not thinking much about serious things
senses.chn: 不计后果的；考虑不周的；不动脑筋的

senses.def: not neat or well arranged; in a state of confusion
senses.chn: 不整洁的；不整齐的；凌乱的

ex.en: an untidy desk
ex.cn: 凌乱的办公桌

ex.en: untidy hair
ex.cn: 蓬乱的头发

senses.def: not keeping things neat or well organized

ex.en: Why do you have to be so untidy?
ex.cn: 你为什么非得这么邋遢？

senses.def: to undo a knot in sth; to undo sth that is tied

ex.en: to untie a knot
ex.cn: 解开绳结

ex.en: I quickly untied the package and peeped inside.
ex.cn: 我迅速拆开包裹，往里瞥了一眼。

ex.en: He untied the rope and pushed the boat into the water.
ex.cn: 他解开缆绳，把小船推入水中。

senses.def: up to the point in time or the event mentioned

ex.en: Let's wait until the rain stops.
ex.cn: 咱们等雨停了吧。

ex.en: Until she spoke I hadn't realized she wasn't English.
ex.cn: 直到她开口说话我才知道她不是英格兰人。

ex.en: You're not going out until you've finished this.
ex.cn: 你没把这事做完就不准出去。

ex.en: Until now I have always lived alone.
ex.cn: 直到现在，我一直独自生活。

ex.en: They moved here in 2009. Until then they'd always been in the London area.
ex.cn: 他们 2009 年搬到这里，之前一直住在伦敦地区。

ex.en: He continued working up until his death.
ex.cn: 他一直工作到去世。

senses.def: happening too soon or sooner than is normal or expected
senses.chn: 过早的；不到时间的；突然的

ex.en: She met a tragic and untimely death at 25.
ex.cn: 她于 25 岁时不幸猝然辞世。

senses.def: happening at a time or in a situation that is not suitable

ex.en: His interruption was untimely.
ex.cn: 他的插话不是时候。

senses.def: continuing to do sth for a long period of time with a lot of effort and/or enthusiasm
senses.chn: 不知疲劳的；孜孜不倦的；坚持不懈的

senses.def: without a title
senses.chn: 无题的（表示不标明题目或没有名称）

senses.def: to or towards sb/sth

ex.en: The angel appeared unto him in a dream.
ex.cn: 在梦中天使出现在他面前。

senses.def: until a particular time or event

ex.en: The knights swore loyalty unto death.
ex.cn: 骑士们宣誓至死效忠。

senses.def: used to emphasize how large, great, unpleasant, etc. sth is

ex.en: untold misery/wealth
ex.cn: 极度的痛苦；巨额财富

ex.en: These gases cause untold damage to the environment.
ex.cn: 这些气体对环境造成难以估计的破坏。

senses.def: not told to anyone
a person who is untouchable is in a position where they are unlikely to be punished or criticized
senses.chn: 不可处罚（或批评）的；管不了的

ex.en: Given his political connections, he thought he was untouchable.
ex.cn: 他有一些政界关系，所以自认为谁也管不了他。

senses.def: that cannot be touched or changed by other people

ex.en: The department's budget is untouchable.
ex.cn: 这个部门的预算是不容变动的。

senses.def: (in India in the past) belonging to or connected with the Hindu social class (or caste) that was considered by other classes to be the lowest
senses.chn: （旧时印度）贱民的，不可接触者的

senses.def: (in India in the past) a member of a Hindu social class (or caste) that was considered by other classes to be the lowest
not affected by sth, especially sth bad or unpleasant; not damaged
senses.chn: 未受影响；未被损害；原封未动

ex.en: The area has remained relatively untouched by commercial development.
ex.cn: 相对而言，这个地区至今没怎么受到商业开发的影响。

senses.def: not eaten or drunk

ex.en: She left her meal untouched.
ex.cn: 她的饭连动都没动。

senses.def: not changed in any way

ex.en: The final clause in the contract will be left untouched.
ex.cn: 合同的最后一项条款将不作改动。

senses.def: unusual and unexpected, and usually unpleasant
senses.chn: 异常的；意外的；不幸的；棘手的

ex.en: That's the plan—unless anything untoward happens.
ex.cn: 计划就这么定了，除非出现异常情况。

ex.en: He had noticed nothing untoward.
ex.cn: 他没有注意到有何特殊情况。

senses.def: not trained to perform a particular job or skill; without formal training in sth
senses.chn: 没有训练的；未经正规培训的

ex.en: untrained in keyboard skills
ex.cn: 未经键盘操作技能训练的

ex.en: untrained teachers
ex.cn: 未经正规培训的教师

ex.en: To the untrained eye, the products look remarkably similar.
ex.cn: 这些产品在没有受过专门训练的人看来几乎一模一样。

senses.def: not restricted or limited by sth
senses.chn: 不受限制的；无拘束的；自由自在的

senses.def: not receiving medical treatment

ex.en: If untreated, the illness can become severe.
ex.cn: 若不加以治疗，病情就可能会变得很严重。

senses.def: not made safe by chemical or other treatment

ex.en: untreated sewage
ex.cn: 未处理的污水

senses.def: not treated with substances to preserve it
without experience of doing a particular job

ex.en: She chose two untried actors for the leading roles.
ex.cn: 她选了两个没有经验的演员饰演主角。

senses.def: not yet tried or tested to discover if it works or is successful
senses.chn: 未检验的；未经考验（或试验）的

ex.en: This is a new and relatively untried procedure.
ex.cn: 这是个未经多少试验的新程序。

senses.def: not true; not based on facts
senses.chn: 不真实的；假的；无事实根据的

ex.en: These accusations are totally untrue.
ex.cn: 这些指控纯属捏造。

ex.en: an untrue claim
ex.cn: 不真实的说法

ex.en: It is untrue to say that something like this could never happen again.
ex.cn: 说这类事情再也不会发生是毫无事实根据的。

senses.def: not loyal to sb/sth

ex.en: If he agreed to their demands, he would have to be untrue to his own principles.
ex.cn: 假使答应他们的要求，他就得背叛自己的原则。

senses.def: that cannot be trusted
senses.chn: 不可靠的；不能信赖（或信任）的

senses.def: a lie. People often say 'untruth' to avoid saying 'lie'.
senses.chn: （lie 的委婉说法）妄语，诳语，假话

senses.def: the state of being false
saying things that you know are not true
to try every possible course of action in order to find or achieve sth
not having been formally taught about sth
senses.chn: 未接受正规教育的；未受过正式训练的

senses.def: not typical
senses.chn: 不典型的；无代表性的；无特征的

ex.en: an untypical example
ex.cn: 非典型的例子

ex.en: Schools in this area are quite untypical of schools in the rest of the country.
ex.cn: 这个地区的学校根本不能代表全国其他地区的学校。

ex.en: All in all, it had been a not untypical day (= it had been very like other days).
ex.cn: 总而言之，那一天平平常常，并没有什么特别。

senses.def: in such a bad condition or of such low quality that it cannot be used
senses.chn: （破得或差得）不能使用的；破烂不堪的

senses.def: not being used at the moment; never having been used
senses.chn: 没用着的；闲着的；未用过的

senses.def: not having much experience of sth and therefore not knowing how to deal with it; not used to sth
senses.chn: 经验少；不习惯；不熟悉；不惯于

ex.en: This is an easy routine, designed for anyone who is unused to exercise.
ex.cn: 这是一套简单的固定动作，是为不常锻炼的人设计的。

ex.en: She was unused to talking about herself.
ex.cn: 她不习惯谈论自己。

example.en: This is an easy routine, designed for anyone who is unused to exercise.
example.cn: 这是一套简单的固定动作，是为不常锻炼的人设计的。

example.en: She was unused to talking about herself.
example.cn: 她不习惯谈论自己。

senses.def: different from what is usual or normal
senses.chn: 特别的；不寻常的；罕见的

ex.en: It's unusual for the trees to flower so early.
ex.cn: 这种树这么早开花很少见。

ex.en: She has a very unusual name.
ex.cn: 她的名字很特别。

ex.en: It's not unusual for young doctors to work a 70-hour week (= it happens often).
ex.cn: 年轻的医生每周工作 70 小时并不罕见。

senses.def: different from other similar things and therefore interesting and attractive
senses.chn: 独特的；与众不同的；别致的

ex.en: an unusual colour
ex.cn: 特别的颜色

senses.def: used before adjectives to emphasize that a particular quality is greater than normal
senses.chn: （置于形容词前，用以强调）特别地，极，非常

ex.en: unusually high levels of radiation
ex.cn: 超高的辐射强度

ex.en: an unusually cold winter
ex.cn: 异常寒冷的冬天

senses.def: used to say that a particular situation is not normal or expected

ex.en: Unusually for him, he wore a tie.
ex.cn: 他破例打了一条领带。

senses.def: used to emphasize how great a particular emotion or quality is

ex.en: unutterable sadness
ex.cn: 无法形容的悲伤

senses.def: with nothing added
senses.chn: 不加掩饰的；质朴的；坦率的

ex.en: It was the plain unvarnished truth.
ex.cn: 这是简单确凿的事实。

senses.def: not covered with varnish
senses.chn: 未加涂层的；未涂清漆的

senses.def: never changing
senses.chn: 从无变化的；固定的；恒久的

ex.en: an unvarying routine
ex.cn: 不变的常规

senses.def: to remove a cover or curtain from a painting, statue, etc. so that it can be seen in public for the first time
senses.chn: 为…揭幕；揭开…上的覆盖物；拉开…的帷幔

ex.en: The Queen unveiled a plaque to mark the official opening of the hospital.
ex.cn: 女王主持揭幕式，标志着医院正式启用。

senses.def: to show or introduce a new plan, product, etc. to the public for the first time
senses.chn: （首次）展示，介绍，推出；将…公之于众

ex.en: They will be unveiling their new models at the Motor Show.
ex.cn: 他们将在汽车展上首次推出自己的新型汽车。

senses.def: thought about but not expressed in words
senses.chn: （想法）未用语言表达的，未说出的

senses.def: produced without moving your vocal cords; not voiced

ex.en: unvoiced consonants such as 'p' and 't'
ex.cn: 清辅音如 /p/ 和 /t/

senses.def: not earning money by working
senses.chn: 无工资收入的；不挣钱的

senses.def: for which you are not paid
people who are unwaged
that you do not want
senses.chn: 不需要的；多余的；不受欢迎的

ex.en: unwanted advice
ex.cn: 多余的劝告

ex.en: unwanted pregnancies
ex.cn: 非意愿妊娠

ex.en: It is very sad when children feel unwanted (= feel that other people do not care about them).
ex.cn: 小孩觉得没有人爱是很悲惨的。

senses.def: not reasonable or necessary; not appropriate
senses.chn: 不合理的；不必要的；无正当理由的；不适当的

ex.en: Much of the criticism was totally unwarranted.
ex.cn: 这种批评基本上是毫无道理的。

senses.def: not aware of the possible dangers or problems of a situation and therefore likely to be harmed in some way
people who are unwary

ex.en: The stock market is full of traps for the unwary.
ex.cn: 对无风险意识的人而言，股票市场充满了陷阱。

senses.def: not washed; dirty

ex.en: a pile of unwashed dishes
ex.cn: 一堆未洗的碟子

ex.en: Their clothes were dirty and their hair unwashed.
ex.cn: 他们衣服肮脏，头发未洗。

senses.def: not changing or becoming weaker in any way
senses.chn: 不动摇的；坚定的；始终如一的

ex.en: unwavering support
ex.cn: 坚定不移的支持

senses.def: not wanted
senses.chn: 不需要的；不受欢迎的；多余的

ex.en: an unwelcome visitor
ex.cn: 不受欢迎的访客

ex.en: To avoid attracting unwelcome attention he kept his voice down.
ex.cn: 为避免引起不必要的注意，他把声音压低了。

senses.def: not friendly towards sb who is visiting or arriving
senses.chn: （对造访者）不亲切的，不热情的，冷淡的

senses.def: not attractive; looking uncomfortable to be in
senses.chn: 不惬意的；无亲切感的；不温馨的

senses.def: ill/sick

ex.en: She said she was feeling unwell and went home.
ex.cn: 她说她感觉不舒服回家了。

senses.def: harmful to health; not looking healthy
senses.chn: 有损健康的；不健康的；不卫生的

senses.def: that you consider unpleasant or not natural
senses.chn: 令人不快的；讨厌的；不自然的

senses.def: difficult to move or control because of its size, shape or weight
senses.chn: 笨重的；笨拙的；不灵巧的

senses.def: difficult to control or organize because it is very large or complicated
senses.chn: 难控制（或操纵、管理）的；运转不灵的；尾大不掉的

senses.def: not wanting to do sth and refusing to do it

ex.en: They are unwilling to invest any more money in the project.
ex.cn: 他们不想在这个项目上再增加投资。

ex.en: She was unable, or unwilling, to give me any further details.
ex.cn: 她不能，或不愿意，向我提供进一步的细节。

senses.def: not wanting to do or be sth, but forced to by other people
senses.chn: 勉强的；无奈的；迫不得已的

ex.en: an unwilling hero
ex.cn: 自己不愿却被抬举的英雄

ex.en: He became the unwilling object of her attention.
ex.cn: 他受到她的青睐实非所愿。

senses.def: to undo sth that has been wrapped into a ball or around sth
senses.chn: 解开，打开，松开（卷绕之物）

ex.en: to unwind a ball of string
ex.cn: 解开一团绳

ex.en: He unwound his scarf from his neck.
ex.cn: 他从脖子上解下围巾。

ex.en: The bandage gradually unwound and fell off.
ex.cn: 绷带逐渐松开脱落了。

senses.def: to stop worrying or thinking about problems and start to relax

ex.en: Music helps me unwind after a busy day.
ex.cn: 音乐使我在忙碌一天后得以放松。

senses.def: showing a lack of good judgement
senses.chn: 愚蠢的；不明智的；轻率的

ex.en: It would be unwise to comment on the situation without knowing all the facts.
ex.cn: 不全面了解情况就对局势妄加评论是不明智的。

ex.en: an unwise investment
ex.cn: 不明智的投资

senses.def: not aware of what you are doing or of the situation you are involved in
senses.chn: 不知情的；糊里糊涂的；无意的

ex.en: He became an unwitting accomplice in the crime.
ex.cn: 他糊里糊涂地成了犯罪的帮凶。

ex.en: She was the unwitting cause of the argument.
ex.cn: 她无意中引起了这场争执。

senses.def: without being aware of what you are doing or the situation that you are involved in
senses.chn: 糊里糊涂地；茫然；无意地

ex.en: She had broken the law unwittingly, but still she had broken it.
ex.cn: 她并非故意犯法，但毕竟是犯了法。

senses.def: not usual or expected
senses.chn: 不平常的；异常的；罕见的；没想到的

ex.en: He spoke with unwonted enthusiasm.
ex.cn: 他讲话显得出人意料的热心。

senses.def: not practical or possible to do successfully
senses.chn: 不切实际的；难以实行的；行不通的

ex.en: an unworkable plan
ex.cn: 不切实际的计划

ex.en: The law as it stands is unworkable.
ex.cn: 照现在的情形，这条法律是难以执行的。

senses.def: not interested in money or the things that it buys
senses.chn: 不慕金钱的；对钱财无兴趣的

senses.def: lacking experience of life
having qualities that do not seem to belong to this world
senses.chn: 非现世的；非尘世的；超凡的

ex.en: The landscape had a stark, unworldly beauty.
ex.cn: 那景色有一种简朴、超凡的美。

senses.def: not worried; calm; relaxed

ex.en: She appeared unworried by criticism.
ex.cn: 她看上去并不在乎挨批评。

senses.def: not having the necessary qualities to deserve sth, especially respect

ex.en: He considered himself unworthy of the honour they had bestowed on him.
ex.cn: 他认为自己不配得到大家赋予他的荣誉。

senses.def: not acceptable from sb, especially sb who has an important job or high social position
senses.chn: 格格不入的；不能接受的；（与…的身份）不相称的

ex.en: Such opinions are unworthy of educated people.
ex.cn: 知识分子发表这样的言论有失身份。

senses.def: to take off the paper, etc. that covers or protects sth
senses.chn: 打开（或解开、拆开）…的包装

ex.en: Don't unwrap your present until your birthday.
ex.cn: 生日礼物要等到你生日那天再打开。

senses.def: a law, etc. that everyone knows about and accepts even though it has not been made official
senses.chn: 非书面的，不成文的，惯常的（法律、规定、协议等）

ex.en: an unwritten understanding that nobody leaves before five o'clock
ex.cn: 五点钟之前谁都不离开的默契

senses.def: not yet written

ex.en: The photographs were to be included in his as yet unwritten autobiography.
ex.cn: 这些照片准备要收入他那尚未写的自传之中。

senses.def: if a person is unyielding, they are not easily influenced and they are unlikely to change their mind
senses.chn: 坚定的；顽强不屈的；固执的

senses.def: an unyielding substance or object does not bend or break when pressure is put on it
if you unzip a piece of clothing, a bag, etc., or if it unzips, you open it by undoing the zip that fastens it
senses.chn: 拉开…的拉锁；…的拉锁被拉开

senses.def: to return a file to its original size after it has been compressed (= made smaller)
towards or in a higher position
senses.chn: 向（或在）较高位置；向上；在上面

ex.en: He jumped up from his chair.
ex.cn: 他从椅子上跳起来。

ex.en: The sun was already up (= had risen) when they set off.
ex.cn: 他们出发时太阳已经升起来了。

ex.en: They live up in the mountains.
ex.cn: 他们住在山区。

ex.en: It didn't take long to put the tent up.
ex.cn: 没用多长时间就搭完帐篷了。

ex.en: I pinned the notice up on the wall.
ex.cn: 我把通知钉在墙上了。

ex.en: Lay the cards face up (= facing upwards) on the table.
ex.cn: 把纸牌正面朝上摆在桌子上。

senses.def: to or at a higher level
senses.chn: 向（或在）较高水平；加大；增高

ex.en: She turned the volume up.
ex.cn: 她把音量调大了。

ex.en: Prices are still going up (= rising).
ex.cn: 物价还在上涨。

ex.en: United were 3–1 up at half-time.
ex.cn: 半场结束时，联队以 3:1 领先。

ex.en: The wind is getting up (= blowing more strongly).
ex.cn: 风渐渐大起来了。

ex.en: Sales are well up on last year.
ex.cn: 销量比去年大幅增加。

ex.en: Student numbers in English language schools in this country increased from 66 000 in 2008 to just over 84 000 in 2009.
ex.cn: 这个国家英语语言学校的学生人数从 2008 年的 66 000 增长到 2009 年的 84 000 多一点。

senses.def: to the place where sb/sth is
senses.chn: 朝（某人或某物）的方向；向…的地方

ex.en: A car drove up and he got in.
ex.cn: 一辆汽车开过来，他就上了车。

ex.en: She went straight up to the door and knocked loudly.
ex.cn: 她径直走到门前大声敲门。

ex.en: As usual at that hour, the place was deserted.
ex.cn: 跟平常那个时刻一样，那地方空荡荡的。

ex.en: Despite her problems, she carried on working as usual.
ex.cn: 尽管她有困难，她照样继续工作。

senses.def: a way of saying that things will continue as normal despite a difficult situation
senses.chn: （尽管处境困难）一切照常，不受干扰

senses.def: in the way that is normal or usual; as often happens

ex.en: Everyone blamed me as per usual.
ex.cn: 大家照例是责怪我。

example.en: It is usual to start a speech by thanking everybody for coming.
example.cn: 讲话前先感谢大家光临，这是惯例。

senses.def: in the way that is usual or normal; most often
senses.chn: 通常地；正常地；一般地；经常地

ex.en: I'm usually home by 6 o'clock.
ex.cn: 我一般 6 点钟回到家。

ex.en: We usually go by car.
ex.cn: 我们通常开汽车去。

ex.en: How long does the journey usually take?
ex.cn: 这段旅程通常需要多长时间？

senses.def: a person who lends money to people at unfairly high rates of interest
lending money at very high rates of interest

the practice of lending money to people at unfairly high rates of interest

senses.def: united

the belief that the right course of action is the one that will produce the greatest happiness of the greatest number of people
a service provided for the public, for example an electricity, water or gas supply

senses.def: the quality of being useful
a piece of computer software that performs a particular task
senses.chn: 实用程序；公用程序；工具

senses.def: that can be used for several different purposes
senses.chn: 多用途的；多效用的；多功能的

ex.en: an all-round utility player (= one who can play equally well in several different positions in a sport)
ex.cn: 全面型选手

senses.def: a room, especially in a private house, that contains large pieces of equipment such as a washing machine, freezer, etc.

ex.en: The Romans were the first to utilize concrete as a building material.
ex.cn: 罗马人首先使用混凝土作建筑材料。

ex.en: The resources at our disposal could have been better utilized.
ex.cn: 我们所掌握的资源本来可以利用得更好。

senses.def: greatest; most extreme

ex.en: This is a matter of the utmost importance.
ex.cn: 这是个极其重要的问题。

ex.en: You should study this document with the utmost care.
ex.cn: 你对这份文件的研究应该慎之又慎。

senses.def: the greatest amount possible
senses.chn: 最大量；最大限度；极限；最大可能

ex.en: Our resources are strained to the utmost.
ex.cn: 我们的资源极端紧缺。

ex.en: He did his utmost (= tried as hard as possible) to persuade me not to go.
ex.cn: 他使尽浑身解数劝我别去。

senses.def: an imaginary place or state in which everything is perfect
senses.chn: 乌托邦；空想的完美境界

senses.def: having a strong belief that everything can be perfect, often in a way that does not seem to be realistic or practical
senses.chn: 乌托邦的；空想完美主义的

ex.en: utopian ideals
ex.cn: 不切实际的理想

ex.en: a utopian society
ex.cn: 乌托邦式社会

senses.def: used to emphasize how complete sth is

ex.en: That's complete and utter nonsense!
ex.cn: 那纯属一派胡言！

ex.en: To my utter amazement she agreed.
ex.cn: 令我大感意外的是，她同意了。

ex.en: He felt an utter fool.
ex.cn: 他觉得自己蠢到家了。

senses.def: to make a sound with your voice; to say sth

ex.cn: 发出喊叫声

ex.en: She did not utter a word during lunch (= said nothing).
ex.cn: 进午餐时，她一言未发。
